questions.question: What is the highest-grossing film of all time globally (unadjusted for inflation)?
questions.explanation: James Cameron's 2009 sci-fi epic Avatar has grossed over $2.92 Billion worldwide across multiple re-releases.
questions.funFact: James Cameron waited over 10 years to film Avatar until 3D camera technology caught up with his vision!

questions.question: Which superhero movie won Heath Ledger a posthumous Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor?
questions.explanation: Heath Ledger won the Oscar for his iconic performance as the Joker in Christopher Nolan's 2008 masterpiece The Dark Knight.
questions.funFact: Heath Ledger spent a month locked alone in a London hotel room developing the Joker's eerie voice, mannerisms, and diary!

questions.question: In the Netflix smash-hit 'Stranger Things', what is the name of the parallel dark dimension?
questions.explanation: The dark alternate reflection of Hawkins, Indiana is known throughout the series as The Upside Down.
questions.funFact: The Duffer Brothers initially pitched the show under the working title 'Montauk'!
